thread:
marie: quick RFC follow-up: we need to lock down service auth fallbacks. a recent deploy let infra routes accept org keys when project keys absent and blamed billing.
anita: saw that. sounding board: project-key -> ephemeral-service-token -> org-key (explicit opt-in only). ephemeral preferred.
kevin: ephemeral looks good but depends on broker latency. suggest fail-fast if broker unreachable, not silent org-key use.
marie: agreed. propose route-level flag `fallback_policy` with values [deny, ephemeral-only, ephemeral-with-org-exception]. default=deny.
ravi: add logging requirement: every fallback emits structured event and increments auth.fallback.metric with tag route=<id>.
anita: SDK change: return AUTH_NO_PROJECT_KEY and include header `X-Fallback=AUTO` when used. ops should alert on fallback rate spikes.
ops-bot: note: schedule canary 2024-09-20T01:00Z. add monitor datadog.auth.fallback.rate.
kevin: action items: 1) eng-auth implement ephemeral mint + circuit-breaker (kevin) 2) platform add `fallback_policy` and CI linter (marie) 3) security draft exception process (anita).
marie: we'll start with ephemeral-only on internal routes, measure attribution and latency, then consider org exceptions with review.
